name: Transition Kit
summary: 30+ page transition and theme toggle templates for the View Transitions API, installable via the shadcn CLI.
description: Pre-built theme toggles and page transition templates powered by the View Transitions API — fade, slide, scale, flip, blur, mask reveals and 3D moves. Components install through the shadcn CLI and inject CSS into the ::view-transition-* pseudo-elements; a guide covers edge cases like back/forward navigation and prefers-reduced-motion.
contains: 30+ page transition and theme toggle templates
4 theme toggle components: animated toggler, text-cycling button, iOS-style switch, segmented switcher
theme toggles install via the shadcn CLI (@shadcn registry)
templates: GIF masks, circle/polygon reveals, clock wipe, fade, slide, flip, blur, cube, page-curl
edge-case guide: direct links, hard reloads, back/forward, unsupported browsers, reduced motion
browser support noted for Chrome/Edge/Opera 111+ with graceful fallbacks
